scope: Read-only child-control source review; no tests, compiler, process inspection or Docker calls.
basis: The original three-second context begins before Start and governs the exact CommandContext-owned child through cleanup.
Successful observation requires stdin EOF followed by a successful sole Wait. Failure cleanup checks Wait and only accepts an expired original context with an exact SIGKILL exit status.

Cleanup is registered immediately after successful Start, before pidfd acquisition. Input and pidfd closes are checked and marked consumed before close; Wait is recorded before any fatal assertion, preventing duplicate waits.
No process is adopted from observed metadata and no fresh cleanup deadline is introduced.
limits: Source closure only. The actual anchored child control has not been executed by this reviewer.
Physical bounds for unpreemptible OS reap are not established.
This does not close broader historical refresh error-owner retention or installed lifecycle qualification.
